name.description: the metric's own name, as its defining source writes it, e.g. Context Precision

category.description: what part of a system the metric scores (its family)

measures.description: one sentence: what a high score means

needs.description: what must be supplied to compute it, e.g. question, retrieved contexts, answer, reference answer

judged_by.description: what decides the score in the defining source: a fixed computation, a model, or human assessors

min.description: lowest value the metric takes; null when it has no lower bound

max.description: highest value the metric takes; null when it has no upper bound

range.description: the range as the defining source states it; omitted when the source states none

direction.description: which way a better system moves the value

defined_in.description: the paper or documentation page that defines the metric

implemented_by.description: IDs of framework records (frameworks repo) whose documentation implements the metric as defined

related_metrics.description: IDs of metrics that measure something close to this one
